name: Card sections
description: Three cards for marketing pages: a row of instruments read by a passing line of light, an image card that wakes on hover, and a journal card.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading under the instruments, set in the display face.

props.name: description
props.description: One line of supporting text.

props.name: instruments
props.description: The instruments, each shown in a circle with its label. Each one swells and takes the light colour as the line passes it.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one sweep of the line.

props.name: pause
props.description: Seconds between sweeps.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the line and of an instrument while it is lit.

props.name: src
props.description: The image that fills the card.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text for the image.

props.name: title
props.description: The card's heading, at the bottom over the image.

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence under the heading.

props.name: meta
props.description: A short line above the heading, such as a region and season.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the heading a link that covers the whole card. Keyboard focus starts the same motion as hover.

props.name: colors
props.description: The three colours of the wash that crosses the image on hover.

props.name: src
props.description: The article's image.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text for the image.

props.name: title
props.description: The article's title, set in the display face.

props.name: excerpt
props.description: The opening of the article, clamped to two lines.

props.name: author
props.description: Shown with a small avatar above the title. Without an image the avatar shows initials.

props.name: readingTime
props.description: Shown after the author's name, for example "7 min read".

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the title a link that covers the whole card.
